# Slider

Adjusts a **writable number** such as light brightness, cover position or an input number.

<div class="widget-previews">
<figure><a href="../img/gallery/vertical_glow.png"><img src="../img/gallery/vertical_glow.png" alt="Vertical, Glow style" loading="lazy" width="120" height="240" style="width: 96px"></a></figure>
</div>

## Entities

| Entity | Domains |
| --- | --- |
| Writable number | light brightness, cover position, an input number and the like |

## Requirements

None beyond the entities.

## Options

| Option | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Slider entity type | what the slider sets |
| Slider direction | auto, left to right, right to left, bottom to top or top to bottom |
| Slider accent color | the colour of the bar |

## On the panel

- Drag or tap the bar to set the value directly.

## Size

- Minimum: **100 × 100 px**.
- Maximum: **dashboard width × dashboard height**, capped by the display's dashboard area.

The minimum is a validation limit, not a recommended size. [Choose your display](../choose-display.md) lists the dashboard geometry; [Widget anatomy](../widget-anatomy.md) explains spacing and touch targets.
